lessons: A market proxy that returns exactly +0.00% makes every component's unexplained share 100% by arithmetic, not by discovery; read the sigma, not the share.
An event's importance and its price impact are different measurements, and the page must report the first even when the second is absent.
A schedule can be failing while every one of its runs succeeds; only a rule counting owed-against-arrived firings sees it.
